_meta.notes: Comprehensive index for United Arab Emirates covering ancient Magan (Umm al-Nar), pearl diving economy, Portuguese/Dutch/British presence, Trucial States (British protectorate 1820-1971), Abu Dhabi oil discovery 1958, federation formation 1971 (7 emirates), oil wealth transformation from desert sheikhdoms to global hub, Dubai's rise, expatriate majority, Abu Dhabi-Dubai dynamics, Yemen war intervention, Abraham Accords 2020, and authoritarian modernization.

religion.note: Islam is official religion; Sunni majority; relatively tolerant by Gulf standards (churches, Hindu temples allowed in enclaves); sharia influences law but dual system; alcohol available in hotels/clubs; expatriate diversity

ethnic_groups.name: Emirati (Arab)
ethnic_groups.notes: Citizens tiny minority; tribal (Bani Yas, Qawasim); privileged welfare state; Abu Dhabi ruling Al Nahyan; Dubai ruling Al Maktoum; each emirate has ruling family; 'nationals'

ethnic_groups.name: South Asian (Indian, Pakistani, Bangladeshi, Sri Lankan)
ethnic_groups.notes: Largest bloc; Indians ~2.75M (largest group); construction, services, professionals; kafala system; Dubai Creek/Bur Dubai; remittances; Hindi/Malayalam speakers; Hindu temples (BAPS Abu Dhabi)

ethnic_groups.name: Western and Other
ethnic_groups.notes: Expat professionals; Western compounds; diverse global workforce

country_profile.notes_unique: Federation of 7 emirates: Abu Dhabi (capital, oil-rich, 87% land, Al Nahyan rulers), Dubai (commerce, tourism, Al Maktoum rulers, Burj Khalifa 828m tallest building), Sharjah, Ajman, Umm al-Quwain, Ras al-Khaimah, Fujairah; expats outnumber citizens 9:1; Dubai diversified from oil; Burj Al Arab (7-star); palm islands; Expo 2020; Abraham Accords (Israel normalization); Yemen war (2015+); kafala labor system; no income tax; Louvre/Guggenheim Abu Dhabi; Formula 1

natural_resources.notes: 7th largest proven oil reserves globally (~100B barrels); significant natural gas; heavy investment in post-oil economy; Masdar City (renewable energy showcase).

military.notes: High military spending per capita; involved in Yemen coalition (2015-2019, withdrew); advanced weapons (F-35 pending, Rafale, Leclerc tanks); domestic defense industry growing (EDGE Group); Abraham Accords signatory.

trade_agreements: CEPA with India, Israel, Indonesia, Turkey

infrastructure.notes: Etihad Rail (national railway) under construction; Dubai Metro (pilotless); hyperloop research; Etisalat/du among fastest 5G globally; digital government leaders (100% e-services).

climate_environment.notes: COP28 host (Dubai 2023); among highest per capita CO2 emitters; 97% water from desalination; Net Zero by 2050 Strategy; mangrove restoration; extreme heat challenge (50C+ summers).

debt_aid.notes: Major foreign aid donor (among top globally relative to GNI); ADIA (~$900B+) one of world's largest sovereign wealth funds; no income tax but 9% corporate tax from 2023; low public debt.

education.notes: Branch campuses of major global universities; bilingual (Arabic/English) education; high enrollment but PISA below OECD average; Mohammed bin Rashid Space Centre; emphasis on STEM.

diaspora_migration.immigration_policy: Kafala (sponsorship) system; Golden Visa (10-year); Emirati citizenship pathway (exceptional talent)
diaspora_migration.notes: ~90% of population is expatriate; world's largest remittance outflow country; Indians largest community (~3.5M); Golden Visa attracting long-term residents; no path to citizenship for most expats.

digital_economy.notes: World's first Minister of AI; blockchain strategy; Smart Dubai 2021; highest global e-government index among Arab states; Careem (ride-hailing unicorn, acquired by Uber); Hub71 startup ecosystem.

geography.terrain: Flat coastal plain; vast desert interior (Rub al Khali); Hajar Mountains in east; sabkha salt flats
geography.notes: Federation of 7 emirates (Abu Dhabi, Dubai, Sharjah, Ajman, Umm Al Quwain, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah); Abu Dhabi holds 90% of land area; hyper-arid climate; no permanent rivers.

economy_extended.notes: Oil revenue ~30% GDP (declining share); most diversified Gulf economy; Dubai services/tourism hub; Abu Dhabi sovereign wealth (ADIA ~$900B+, Mubadala ~$300B); AED pegged to USD; no income tax (9% corporate tax from 2023).

health.notes: World-class healthcare facilities; mandatory health insurance; Cleveland Clinic/Mayo Clinic affiliates; high diabetes/obesity rates; among highest COVID vaccination rates globally (99%+).

food_agriculture.notes: 90% food imported; food security strategic priority; vertical farming/controlled environment agriculture investment; Al Dahra global farmland acquisition; world's largest dates producer/exporter.

energy.notes: OPEC member; Barakah nuclear plant (4x1400MW, first in Arab world, operational 2021-2024); Noor Abu Dhabi solar (world's largest single-site solar project at commissioning); Al Dhafra solar 2GW; desalination powered by energy sector.

transport.national_airline: Emirates (Dubai), Etihad Airways (Abu Dhabi), Air Arabia (Sharjah), flydubai
transport.notes: DXB world's busiest international airport; Jebel Ali world's largest man-made harbor and 9th busiest container port; Emirates airline global mega-carrier; Al Maktoum airport planned as world's largest.

unesco_sites_list: Cultural Sites of Al Ain (Hafit, Hili, Bidaa Bint Saud, Oases)
tourism.notes: Dubai most visited city in Middle East; Expo 2020 (held 2021-22) drew 24M visitors; luxury/shopping tourism; MICE (meetings/conferences) hub; Emirati passport among world's most powerful.

human_rights_gender.notes: No elections; hereditary rulers; high government effectiveness; migrant worker (kafala) system criticized; 50% women in parliament (FNC); progressive gender reforms by regional standards; tolerance promoted but dissent not permitted.

security_stability.notes: Very low crime rates; withdrew from Yemen coalition 2019; Abraham Accords with Israel (2020); I2U2 alliance (India-Israel-USA-UAE); Iran offshore islands dispute.

legal_system.sharia_applicability: Personal status for Muslims; some criminal law elements
legal_system.notes: Federal and emirate-level courts; DIFC/ADGM have own common law courts (English law); 2020 legal reforms (cohabitation, alcohol, personal status); Sharia role reduced in recent years.

notable_historical_figures: Sheikh Zayed bin Sultan Al Nahyan (founding father)
Sheikh Rashid bin Saeed Al Maktoum (Dubai builder)
cultural_heritage.media_landscape: State-influenced; Dubai Media City hub; Al Arabiya news; limited press freedom; social media widely used
cultural_heritage.notes: Louvre Abu Dhabi ($1B cultural partnership); Museum of the Future (Dubai); Expo City Dubai; from pearling villages to global cities in 50 years; Emirati identity preservation efforts.

comparative_rankings._note: Country position relative to continent and global.
comparative_rankings.notes: Rankings within Western Asia (18 countries). Highest HDI in Arab world; most diversified Gulf economy; global logistics hub.

current_leader.name: Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan (MBZ)
current_leader.title: President (Ruler of Abu Dhabi)
current_leader.notes: Al Nahyan; succeeded brother Khalifa; de facto ruler since ~2014 (Khalifa incapacitated); strongman; Yemen war architect; Abraham Accords; anti-Muslim Brotherhood; UAE foreign policy assertive; military modernization

vice_president_pm.name: Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum
vice_president_pm.title: Vice President, Prime Minister, Ruler of Dubai
vice_president_pm.notes: Al Maktoum; Dubai vision architect; Burj Khalifa, Palm Jumeirah; horse racing; poet; wife Haya bint Hussein fled 2019 (custody battle, allegations); Dubai Inc model

former_leaders.name: Khalifa bin Zayed Al Nahyan
former_leaders.notes: Al Nahyan; Abu Dhabi ruler; stroke 2014 (incapacitated, brother MBZ de facto ruler); rarely seen publicly; died 2022; Burj Khalifa named after him (bailout)

former_leaders.name: Zayed bin Sultan Al Nahyan
former_leaders.notes: Founding father; Abu Dhabi ruler from 1966; united seven emirates; oil wealth; modernization; 'Father of the Nation'; died 2004; Sheikh Zayed Mosque; revered
